items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I had seen Red Nichols' bands. I used to like them.

ctx.x: And I guess also it wasn't usual for someone to take a whole chorus on a record.
No, the record was all right. It was great! Yeah, that band was great anyhow. I liked Frankie Trumbauer. I had seen Red Nichols' bands. I used to like them.
